text:
My experience with Bangkok Smile was highly disappointing, and others should be fully aware before considering this clinic.

Following their own recommendation, I first underwent a professional cleaning and then the in-office Zoom whitening. Despite this, the whitening result was practically nonexistent. My teeth appeared slightly brighter only on the same day, and within the next days they returned to exactly the same shade as before. The before-and-after photos I shared with the clinic make this extremely clear.

What concerns me even more is that, instead of addressing the complete lack of lasting results, the clinic suggested that I purchase an additional take-home whitening kit. After an ineffective in-office treatment, this was simply not an acceptable solution.

Communication after the appointment was also very slow and inconsistent across WhatsApp, Line, and email, adding to an already frustrating experience.

I am sharing my photos here so that future patients can see the real outcome I received.

For clarity, I do not drink alcohol, coffee, or consume sweets. I follow a clean diet and maintain excellent oral hygiene, so there were no external factors that could have compromised the treatment.

Note that many reviews are written on the same day because they offer a reward at the end of the treatment in exchange for a review. Unfortunately, this is something many clinics do here in Bangkok, so you have to be careful.

I do not recommend Bangkok Smile clinic.
